name: Sangrado de Croma
algorithm: Chroma Bleed — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method detects chroma bleeding artifacts for video forensic analysis:

1. **Chroma Subsampling Análisis**: Video codecs (H.264/H.265) use chroma subsampling (4:2:0, 4:2:2) where chrominance has lower resolution than luminance. The method analyzes whether chroma-luma relationships follow the expected subsampling pattern. Manipulated or AI-generated regions may exhibit chroma bleeding inconsistent with the video's declared subsampling scheme.

2. **Color Canal Borde Alignment**: At sharp edges, the luma (Y) channel shows a precise boundary while chroma channels (Cb, Cr) show slightly broader edges due to subsampling. The method measures the spatial offset between luminance and chrominance edges. Natural video shows consistent chroma spread matching the codec's subsampling. Deepfake insertion may produce regions with different chroma edge characteristics.

3. **Cross - Canal Correlación**: In authentic video, chroma bleeding patterns are consistent across the entire frame (same codec pipeline). The method computes local cross-channel correlations and flags regions where chroma-luma relationships differ from the frame average — indicating content from a different encoding pipeline.

4. **Temporal Chroma Estabilidad**: Chroma bleeding characteristics should remain temporally consistent. The method tracks chroma-luma edge relationships across frames. AI-generated content may produce temporally varying chroma artifacts as the generator independently renders chrominance without modeling the encoding pipeline's subsampling behavior.

5. **Re - Encoding Detección**: Double-encoded video (original + manipulation + re-encoding) produces characteristic double-chroma-bleeding artifacts. The method detects these compound artifacts by analyzing the spectral signature of chroma bleeding, which differs between single-pass and multi-pass encoding chains.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante chroma bleed analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva
